verdict.rationale: Kintsugi supports importing historical transactions (CSV upload or API sync covering the prior full calendar year through today) and determining nexus/threshold crossing dates from that data, which addresses backdated exposure detection. However, there is no evidence of a consolidated liability, penalty, and interest estimate per jurisdiction — the docs describe nexus lookback, registrations, and filings but not a computed exposure/penalty/interest report. missing for 10: per-jurisdiction estimated liability amount, penalty calculation, interest calculation, and a consolidated backdated exposure report/dashboard.
